definitions: A level or rank in an organization, profession, or society.
A line of riders seeking maximum drafting in a crosswind, resulting in a diagonal line across the road.
To form troops into an echelon.

blocks.text: Ecru is a grayish yellow or cream colour. It initially indicated the colour of unbleached linen, and some English dictionaries still define it this way. However, over the years, it has also come to be used for a much darker color.
